tasks.label: Docker: Start Containers (Standard)
tasks.detail: Starts the Docker Compose services in the background.

tasks.label: Docker: Start Containers (with Xdebug)
tasks.detail: Starts the Docker Compose services with Xdebug mode enabled.

tasks.label: Docker: Stop Containers
tasks.detail: Stops and removes the running Docker Compose containers.

tasks.label: Kirby: Scaffold Pages
tasks.detail: Runs Kirby database/page schema scaffolding inside the php8-4 container.

tasks.label: Kirby: Generate TS Types
tasks.detail: Generates TypeScript types for Kirby fields/blueprints.

tasks.label: Kirby: Flush Event Cache
tasks.detail: Flushes the Google Calendar synchronization event cache.

tasks.label: PHP: Code Styling Format (PHP CS Fixer)
tasks.detail: Formats the PHP codebase using rules defined in .php-cs-fixer.dist.php.

tasks.label: PHP: Static Analysis (PHPStan)
tasks.detail: Runs PHPStan static analysis rules defined in phpstan.neon.

tasks.label: Frontend: Run Dev Server
tasks.detail: Starts the local Vite dev server for hot-reloaded assets.

tasks.label: Frontend: Build Production Assets
tasks.detail: Compiles TypeScript files and bundles CSS/JS assets for production.

tasks.label: PHP: Run Pest Tests (All)
tasks.detail: Runs the entire Pest unit and integration test suite.

tasks.label: PHP: Run Pest Tests (Unit)
tasks.detail: Runs only the Pest unit tests.

tasks.label: PHP: Run Pest Tests (Integration)
tasks.detail: Runs only the Pest integration tests.
